note: Read 2026-10-31. Egypt's ministries' sites (manpower.gov.eg, mod.gov.eg) gave no answer today and no official text of the laws was reached. Service: the UK Home Office's Country Policy and Information Note 'Egypt: Military service' (version 3.0, June 2025), which reports Law No. 127 of 1980 on Military and National Service through its sources, marked secondary: service is mandatory for all men aged eighteen to thirty; the original term is three years, cut to one, one and a half or two years by education level (not held: the form holds the ordinary three years, 36 months); then nine to fifteen years in the reserve; women are not conscripted and may serve only as volunteers. A 2026 amendment (Law No. 2 of 2026, to art. 49, on those past thirty who evaded) was reported by a legal-advice site and not verified. Majority: null; the Civil Code (Law No. 131 of 1948), art. 44, sets full age at twenty-one, but its text wasn't read. Work: null; the Child Law (No. 12 of 1996, as amended 2008) and the new Labour Law (No. 14 of 2025) set the minimum working age, and neither was read. The blocker file records the attempts for both.
